targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'subscription_status')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'active')::int AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'apply_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'table_sync_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'lag_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'apply_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'sync_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time
SELECT (data->>'ready_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'total_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription') SELECT tag_data->>'srsubstate' AS state, max((data->>'state_table_count')::bigint) AS tables FROM target_table_sync, latest WHERE target_table_sync.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND tag_data->>'worker_type' = 'apply' ORDER BY time

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot_name, tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'active')::int AS active, data->>'restart_lsn' AS restart_lsn, data->>'confirmed_flush_lsn' AS confirmed_flush_lsn, pg_size_pretty((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint) AS lag, pg_size_pretty((data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::bigint) AS retained_wal, tag_data->>'wal_status' AS wal_status, data->>'safe_wal_size_bytes' AS safe_wal_size_bytes, tag_data->>'invalidation_reason' AS invalidation_reason, tag_data->>'replication_application' AS application, tag_data->>'replication_client_addr' AS client_addr, tag_data->>'replication_state' AS replication_state, (data->>'replication_pid')::bigint AS replication_pid, data->>'sent_lsn' AS sent_lsn, data->>'write_lsn' AS write_lsn, data->>'flush_lsn' AS flush_lsn, data->>'replay_lsn' AS replay_lsn FROM source_replication_slot s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$publisher' ORDER BY slot_name

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'worker_type' AS worker_type, (data->>'pid')::bigint AS pid, (data->>'leader_pid')::bigint AS leader_pid, tag_data->>'relation' AS relation, data->>'received_lsn' AS received_lsn, data->>'latest_end_lsn' AS latest_end_lsn, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_send_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_send_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_receipt_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_receipt_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'latest_end_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS latest_end_time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS message_age_seconds FROM target_subscription s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY worker_type, pid

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'schema' AS schema, tag_data->>'table' AS table, tag_data->>'srsubstate' AS state, data->>'state_name' AS state_name, data->>'synchronization_lsn' AS synchronization_lsn FROM target_table_sync s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY state, schema, table

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_replication_origins WHERE dbname = '$subscriber') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'origin' AS origin, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, (data->>'active')::int AS active_inferred, data->>'remote_lsn' AS remote_lsn, data->>'local_lsn' AS local_lsn, (data->>'origin_count')::bigint AS origin_count, (data->>'active_origin_count')::bigint AS active_origin_count FROM target_replication_origins s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' ORDER BY origin
